info.title: FlyHub Virtual Airlines API
info.description: Read-only airline information and Discord notification payloads for Virtual Airlines integrations. Resources are scoped to the airline that issued the fhva_live bearer key.

tags.name: public-api
tags.description: Read-only resources for airline websites, dashboards, and private integrations.

tags.name: discord-webhooks
tags.description: Discord notification payloads for selected airline activity.

get.description: Returns the profile attached to the bearer key. The airline is derived from the key; no airline ID can be supplied by the caller. This resource is not paginated.
Returns active airline memberships with pilot statistics. Suspended, rejected, left, and removed memberships are excluded. Results are ordered by joinedAt from oldest to newest.

Returns airline logbook activity, newest first. A flagship key includes flights of all non-closed subsidiaries in its own group; a subsidiary or independent airline key includes only its own flights. Inspect each status: a row records airline flight activity and is not automatically a successful completion. Completed and diverted rows include the pilot (display name and public avatar), landing metrics, load, network, simulator, and airport names; those fields are null on rejected and corrected rows. Page deep logbooks with cursor instead of offset; sync new entries with order=asc and the stored nextCursor.

Returns the airline's flights in progress right now, newest first, up to 100. Not paginated. Requires flights:read and uses the same group scope as the flights endpoint. Each request costs 5 rows of the hourly row budget. Results are cached for about 30 seconds, so polling faster returns the same data. No positions, altitudes, or speeds are returned. Offline-tracked flights appear only when the pilot shares them on the live map.

Returns non-retired aircraft ordered by registration. A flagship key includes all non-closed subsidiaries in its own group; a subsidiary or independent airline key includes only its own fleet. Pagination and total apply to the combined fleet. This is a public snapshot and does not expose fleet-management actions.
Returns schedules with active or suspended status, ordered by flight number. Operating-day masks are Monday-first and all date checks in Virtual Airlines use UTC.
Returns one aggregate object. It is not paginated, so use it for summary cards rather than as a substitute for the detail resources.

Totals, monthly activity, top airports, routes and aircraft, and network, simulator and landing breakdowns in one object. Requires statistics:read and costs 20 rows. Results refresh about once a minute.

Investor-style profit and loss: revenue, costs, net result and margin, the previous period for comparison, revenue and cost breakdowns, a daily (or monthly, beyond 92 days) series, highlights and current cash. Requires the opt-in finance:read scope and costs 20 rows. Defaults to the last 30 days. Results refresh about once a minute.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Reporting period. month is the current UTC calendar month to date; 7d to 365d are rolling; all starts at the first recorded transaction. Defaults to 30d.

get.description: Pilots ranked by hours, flights, distance, average score or average landing rate over a period. Requires pilots:read. Results refresh about once a minute.

post.description: FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a flight booking is recorded. The embed may include status, flight number, route, aircraft, pilot, tracking mode, and load when available.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a flight instance is cancelled. The embed may include state, reason, flight number, route, aircraft, and planned times.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a flight result is accepted. The embed may include route, aircraft, pilot, tracking, load, distance, block time, landing rate, score, and settlement context.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a flight result is rejected. The embed may include classification, rejection reason, route, aircraft, pilot, performance, and score.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a pilot application is received and remains pending.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a pilot becomes active in the airline.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a pilot application or membership is rejected.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when an active pilot is suspended.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a suspended pilot becomes active again.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a pilot leaves the airline.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a manager removes a pilot.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a pilot's airline role changes.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when an aircraft or its operating state changes. The embed may include registration, type, station, status, condition, maintenance state, hours, and cycles.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a published route or schedule changes. The embed may include flight number, route, operation type, days, block time, eligible aircraft, and status.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a flight settlement is recorded. It can include flight context, net result, and currency; it is not a complete accounting export.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when airline content is published. The embed includes the public content kind, version, and publication status when available.

vaApiKey.description: A read-only FlyHub VA API key created from Ownership. Keep it on your integration server.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Requested page size. The API uses 25 by default, accepts 1–100, and caps larger values at 100. Invalid values fall back to the default.

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Number of records to skip. The API uses 0 by default and caps values at 10000. For flights, use cursor instead for deep or incremental paging.

FlightStatus.name: status
FlightStatus.description: Optional filter on the logbook status. Omit it to receive every status, including rejected flights. Unknown values are ignored.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from a previous flights page. Replaces offset, has no ceiling and skips the exact total. An invalid cursor is ignored.

Order.name: order
Order.description: desc (default) pages newest first; asc pages oldest first, which an incremental sync uses together with a stored cursor.

Since.name: since
Since.description: Only entries recorded at or after this ISO timestamp.

Until.name: until
Until.description: Only entries recorded before this ISO timestamp.

Aircraft.name: aircraft
Aircraft.description: Only entries flown with this registration (case-insensitive).

Period.name: period
Period.description: Reporting period. month is the current UTC calendar month; 7d to 365d are rolling. Unknown values fall back to all.

LeaderboardMetric.name: metric
LeaderboardMetric.description: Ranking metric. score and landing need at least 3 flights in the period.

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: ETag from an earlier response. When the body is unchanged the API returns 304 and charges one row.

CacheControl.description: The response is private and should not be stored as a shared cache entry.

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed in the current public API window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests remaining in the current public API window.

RateLimitReset.description: ISO timestamp when the public API request window resets.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying after a rate limit.

ETag.description: Weak validator of the response body. Send it back in If-None-Match; an unchanged body returns 304 and costs one row.

RateLimitRowLimit.description: Rows one API key can read per hour.

RateLimitRowRemaining.description: Rows left this hour, the lower of the key and its airline allowance.

RateLimitRowReset.description: ISO timestamp when the hourly row window resets.

RateLimitRowCost.description: Rows this response consumed: the rows returned for a list, a fixed cost for single objects, 1 for a 304.

total.description: Records matching the filters. Null on cursor pages of flights and on the leaderboard.

hasMore.description: Whether another page exists after this one.

nextCursor.description: Flights only. Opaque position to pass as cursor for the next page. With order=asc it is always returned, so an incremental sync can store it.

businessModel.description: Deprecated compatibility field; always null. Airlines no longer have a business-model classification.

avatarUrl.description: Public, unsigned FlyHub avatar URL, or null.

airlineIcao.description: ICAO code of the airline that operated the flight. A flagship key includes non-closed subsidiaries.

pilot.description: Pilot who flew it. null on rejected and corrected rows.

landingRateFpm.description: Touchdown vertical speed in feet per minute (negative while descending). null on rejected and corrected rows or when not recorded.

landingGForce.description: Touchdown G-force, rounded to two decimals.

landingRating.description: FlyHub landing rating, for example greased, great, average, or hard.

passengers.description: Passengers carried, from the dispatch load.

cargoKg.description: Cargo weight in kilograms, from the dispatch load.

network.description: vatsim or ivao when flown on a network, offline when flown off-network, null when unknown.

simulator.description: Simulator name reported by the FlyHub tracker.

createdAt.description: When FlyHub recorded the logbook entry. The since/until filters and cursors use this time.

airlineIcao.description: ICAO code of the airline that operates the schedule. A flagship key includes non-closed subsidiaries.

operatingDaysMask.description: Monday=1, Tuesday=2, Wednesday=4, Thursday=8, Friday=16, Saturday=32, Sunday=64.

username.description: Airline ICAO code followed by Operations.

PublicPilot.description: Public pilot identity: a display name and a public avatar URL only. User IDs are never exposed.

avatarUrl.description: Public, unsigned FlyHub avatar URL, or null when the pilot has no avatar.

airlineIcao.description: ICAO code of the operating airline.

trackingMode.description: online is the live desktop tracker; offline is checkpoint-based offline tracking.

network.description: vatsim or ivao when the pilot is connected right now, offline for offline-tracked flights, null otherwise.

etaAt.description: Estimated arrival: derived from ground speed while airborne, otherwise the planned arrival.

updatedAt.description: Time of the last tracker update.

Insights.description: Aggregates over completed and diverted flights that count for statistics, in the same group scope as flights.

since.description: Start of the period, or null for all time.

flightsByMonth.description: UTC calendar months, oldest first, up to the last 24.

averageLandingRateFpm.description: Average touchdown rate (negative). Closest to zero ranks first for metric=landing.

Finance.description: Profit and loss from the airline ledger, in the same group scope as statistics: a flagship key covers the whole group. Launch capital and group transfers are excluded because they are not performance.

bucket.description: Size of each series entry: days up to 92 days, months beyond.

operatingMarginPercent.description: Net result as a share of revenue; null when there was no revenue.
Net result as a share of revenue; null when there was no revenue.

previous.description: The same length of time just before; month compares with the same days of last month. Null for all.

cashBalance.description: Current airline cash in FH$ (shared across a group).

sharePercent.description: Share of total revenue or costs.

revenueBreakdown.description: Revenue by source, largest first: passengers, cargo, ancillary, contracts.

sharePercent.description: Share of total revenue or costs.

costBreakdown.description: Costs by group, largest first: fleet, fuel, routes and schedules, airports, crew/handling/service, operating programs, penalties and incidents, other.

period.description: YYYY-MM-DD for day buckets, YYYY-MM for month buckets.

Unauthorized.description: A valid FlyHub VA API key is required.

Forbidden.description: The key does not include the required read scope.

RateLimited.description: The request rate is temporarily limited.

ServiceUnavailable.description: FlyHub cannot safely serve the request at the moment.

LiveFlightsResponse.description: Flights in progress right now (up to 100).

NotModified.description: The body has not changed since the ETag sent in If-None-Match. Costs one row.
